ac_summary: AC-1: frontend/eslint.config.js exists and npm run lint exits 0 on a clean checkout (eslint 9 flat config, zero lint errors; violations fixed in this issue)

AC-2: ruleset ships at the seeded minimum (react-hooks + typescript-eslint recommended in devDependencies) and is in effect - resolved config of frontend/src/main.tsx enables react-hooks/rules-of-hooks, react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
AC-3: negative control - a planted any-typed violation in frontend/src reds npm run lint (no-explicit-any named); scratch file removed on both exit paths
AC-4: frontend floor green - vitest >= 30 files / >= 267 tests / 0 failed (base 30/267) + tsc --noEmit rc=0
AC-5: D-03 AC-6 inversion retired in this window - closed D-03.md AC-6 section re-groomed (cites t22, re-groom wording, asserts now-green state) and the now-green state is true (lint rc=0)
AC-6: fix stays on eslint 9 - 9.x devDep, shipped "eslint ." script, zero legacy .eslintrc.* files, flat config exactly frontend/eslint.config.js

verification_commands.ac1:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-1: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f frontend/package.json ] || { echo "FAIL AC-1: not run from the TableQueue repo root (frontend/package.json missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -d frontend/node_modules ] || { echo "FAIL AC-1: not measured - frontend/node_modules is missing (cd frontend && npm install)"; exit 1; }
[ -f frontend/eslint.config.js ] || { echo "FAIL AC-1: frontend/eslint.config.js does not exist (the eslint 9 flat config was never authored)"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p frontend/.scratch
out="frontend/.scratch/_t22ac1_lint.log"
rm -f "$out"
npm --prefix frontend run lint > "$out" 2>&1
rc=$?
if grep -qF "couldn't find an eslint.config.(js|mjs|cjs) file." "$out"; then
  echo "FAIL AC-1: the lint run still reports the eslint 9 flat-config-missing error - the config is not being loaded"
  rm -f "$out"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  exit 1
fi
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -30 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-1: npm run lint exited $rc, want 0 on a clean checkout (violations must be fixed in this issue) - detail above"
  rm -f "$out"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  exit 1
fi
rm -f "$out"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
echo "PASS AC-1: frontend/eslint.config.js exists and npm run lint exits 0 on a clean checkout (eslint 9 flat config, zero lint errors)"
exit 0
verification_commands.ac3:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-3: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f frontend/package.json ] || { echo "FAIL AC-3: not run from the TableQueue repo root (frontend/package.json missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -d frontend/node_modules ] || { echo "FAIL AC-3: not measured - frontend/node_modules is missing (cd frontend && npm install)"; exit 1; }
[ -f frontend/eslint.config.js ] || { echo "FAIL AC-3: frontend/eslint.config.js does not exist - the negative control cannot run"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p frontend/.scratch
out="frontend/.scratch/_t22ac3_lint.log"
rm -f "$out"
probe="frontend/src/_t22ac3_probe.tsx"
printf 'export const probe: any = { x: 1 };\n' > "$probe"
cleanup() { rm -f "$probe" "$out"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; }
trap cleanup EXIT
npm --prefix frontend run lint > "$out" 2>&1
rc=$?
filed=0; grep -qF "_t22ac3_probe" "$out" && filed=1
rule=0; grep -qF "no-explicit-any" "$out" && rule=1
if [ $rc -ne 1 ] && [ $filed -ne 1 ]; then
  tail -20 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-3: the planted any-typed violation in frontend/src did not red the lint run (rc=$rc, file_named=$filed) - the ruleset is not actually linting src (vacuous config)"
  exit 1
fi
if [ $filed -ne 1 ] || [ $rule -ne 1 ]; then
  tail -20 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-3: the lint output does not name the planted file with no-explicit-any (file_named=$filed rule_named=$rule) - detail above"
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-3: negative control - a planted any-typed violation in frontend/src reds npm run lint (rc=$rc, no-explicit-any named), the ruleset actually fires"
exit 0
verification_commands.ac4:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-4: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f frontend/package.json ] || { echo "FAIL AC-4: not run from the TableQueue repo root (frontend/package.json missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -d frontend/node_modules ] || { echo "FAIL AC-4: not measured - frontend/node_modules is missing (cd frontend && npm install)"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p frontend/.scratch
out="frontend/.scratch/_t22ac4.out"
rm -f "$out"
( cd frontend && npx vitest run > "$out" 2>&1 )
rc=$?
files=$(grep -oE "Test Files +[0-9]+ passed \([0-9]+\)" "$out" | grep -oE "[0-9]+" | head -1); files=${files:-0}
tests=$(grep -oE "Tests +[0-9]+ passed \([0-9]+\)" "$out" | grep -oE "[0-9]+" | head -1); tests=${tests:-0}
failed=$(grep -oE "[0-9]+ failed" "$out" | grep -oE "[0-9]+" | head -1); failed=${failed:-0}
if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || [ "$files" -lt 30 ] || [ "$tests" -lt 267 ] || [ "$failed" -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -15 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-4: the frontend floor moved (want rc=0 with >= 30 files, >= 267 tests, 0 failed; got rc=$rc files=$files tests=$tests failed=$failed) - detail above"
  rm -f "$out"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  exit 1
fi
( cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit > "$out" 2>&1 )
rc2=$?
if [ $rc2 -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -15 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-4: tsc --noEmit exited $rc2, want 0 - detail above"
  rm -f "$out"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  exit 1
fi
rm -f "$out"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
echo "PASS AC-4: frontend floor green - vitest $files files / $tests tests passed (floor 30/267, 0 failed) + tsc --noEmit rc=0"
exit 0
verification_commands.ac5:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-5: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f frontend/package.json ] || { echo "FAIL AC-5: not run from the TableQueue repo root (frontend/package.json missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -d frontend/node_modules ] || { echo "FAIL AC-5: not measured - frontend/node_modules is missing (cd frontend && npm install)"; exit 1; }
d03="_docs/issues/closed/D-03.md"
[ -f "$d03" ] || { echo "FAIL AC-5: $d03 not found"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p frontend/.scratch
out="frontend/.scratch/_t22ac5.out"
rm -f "$out" "$out.ac6"
awk '/^- \[ \] \*\*AC-6\*\*/{f=1} f && /^- \[ \] \*\*AC-7\*\*/{exit} f' "$d03" > "$out.ac6"
secs=$(wc -l < "$out.ac6")
if [ "$secs" -lt 10 ]; then
  echo "FAIL AC-5: the AC-6 section of $d03 could not be extracted ($secs lines) - the section heading shape changed"
  rm -f "$out" "$out.ac6"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  exit 1
fi
t22=0; grep -qi "t22" "$out.ac6" && t22=1
rg=0; grep -qi "re-groom" "$out.ac6" && rg=1
if [ "$t22" -ne 1 ] || [ "$rg" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "FAIL AC-5: the D-03 AC-6 section is not re-groomed (t22_provenance=$t22 re-groom_wording=$rg, want 1/1) - the inversion must be retired in this window with t22 as the provenance"
  rm -f "$out" "$out.ac6"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  exit 1
fi
npm --prefix frontend run lint > "$out" 2>&1
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -20 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-5: the now-green state the re-groomed D-03 AC-6 asserts is not true yet - npm run lint exited $rc, want 0 - detail above"
  rm -f "$out" "$out.ac6"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  exit 1
fi
rm -f "$out" "$out.ac6"; rmdir frontend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
echo "PASS AC-5: the D-03 AC-6 inversion is retired - the closed file's AC-6 section cites t22 as the re-groom provenance and asserts the now-green state, which is true (npm run lint rc=0)"
exit 0
